TOK-01.note: Revocation blocks sender and recipient on transfer/transferFrom; issuance and redemption check their one real wallet.

TOK-02.note: Holds block both sides of ordinary routes, issuance and redemption; hold and allowlist are independent.

TOK-03.note: Pause blocks transfer routes and issuance; redemption and recovery still work; unpause restores only valid moves.

TOK-04.note: Role, case, amount, endpoint and destination rules; exact events; failed call leaves the case unused.

TOK-05.note: No burn through the zero address by holder or spender; supply changes are role-gated; fuzzed recovery keeps supply.

TOK-06.note: Deployer gets only admin; allowlist non-zero and admin-only; role admin is admin-only; holds/halts are agent-only.

TOK-07.note: Rejected transferFrom keeps allowance; unlimited allowance does not bypass policy; rejections leave no state or events.
